desc: Ideation: identify per-color feasibility, farthest-to-nearest required chains, and SCS/LCS reduction.
Implement the complete Python solution: read stdin, build inverse permutations, traverse backwards from X in P and Q, check feasibility, build chains, compute SCS length via LIS.
Verify the implementation on the four samples and edge cases: no balls, all balls at X, X fixed point, impossible color cycle, empty chains, and order conflicts requiring duplicated operations.
